description: This file defines a PHP class `Topic` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Cms`. The class handles CRUD operations and listing for CMS topics in an OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for viewing a list of topics, creating/editing a topic, and managing related data such as descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and pagination.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS topics in the OpenCart admin panel. It provides functionality for listing, adding, editing, and deleting topics, along with handling related data such as descriptions, SEO URLs, store associations, and pagination.
